stories.title: Recap — Cubs 17-3 Brewers, Franchise-Record 9 HRs, Bregman 3 HRs
stories.angle: Alex Bregman hit three HRs (6 RBIs) as nine Cubs total homered in the Aug 31 opener — a Cubs franchise record. Clay Holmes threw 6 scoreless IP. Cubs capped August with 62 HRs (NL record for most in a calendar month; 2nd all-time in MLB behind 2019 Yankees' 74). Lead with Bregman/record angle, NOT the score (has_score=False insight).

NINE Cubs left the yard. Franchise record. Clay Holmes threw six scoreless innings against the best team in the NL.

stories.title: September Callups — BJ Murray Jr. Officially a Cub
stories.angle: Sept roster expansion activated today. BJ Murray Jr. (.294/.395/.500, 16 HR, 9 3B at Triple-A Iowa in 118 games) is officially on the roster. Switch-hitter who plays corner infield AND outfield — October-ready depth. Jaxon Wiggins (No. 2 prospect, 4 scoreless Iowa relief outings) not yet officially called up; frame Murray as the confirmed arrival.

The cavalry just arrived.

BJ Murray Jr. is officially a Cub — .294/.395/.500, 16 HR at Triple-A Iowa, and he plays corner infield AND outfield.

Switch-hitter. Versatile. October-ready. Counsell's depth just got a serious upgrade.

stories.title: Cubs Hit 62 HRs in August — NL Record
stories.angle: Cubs' 62-HR August is the most by any NL team in a single calendar month ever. Only the 2019 Yankees (74) hit more in a month in MLB history. Fourth team ever to hit 60+ in a month. Capped by the franchise-record 9-HR game on Aug 31. Deserves its own standalone tweet separate from the game recap.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Chicago hit 62 home runs in August.

That's the most by any NL team in a single calendar month — ever. Only the 2019 Yankees (74) hit more in a month in MLB history.

This offense isn't just hot. It's historically elite.

#Cubs #ChicagoCubs #MLB
